headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 7%. Trump says he may have to destroy the rest of Iran and will decide on strikes soon, but threats without a strike fire no tripwire; Rezaei still refuses to reopen Hormuz or negotiate before Iran's seven conditions are met, and the new tanker fires Iran claims are unnamed and unconfirmed, so the odds hold.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
